title.narrative: Develop and enhance digital literacy of science, math, and multimedia technology educators in Timor-Leste through capacity building and comparative study.

description.narrative: Information, communication, and technology (ICT) have impacted the global society on how to network and impact human life. However, for developing countries like Timor-Leste, there needs to be a gap in how to introduce and integrate it into the education system. They considered the importance of ICT in the education system and realized that capacity building for their educators and the facilities that help support the implementation process is essential. Therefore, the Timor-Leste National Commission for UNESCO (TLNCU) would like to collaborate with the SEAMEO STEM-ED in Thailand to get capacity building related to digital literacy in science and math. After that, TLNCU collaborates with the teacher's training institute in Timor-Leste (INFORDEPE) to train high school science, math, and multimedia teachers on applying and integrating technology in the teaching process. To introduce, create, and develop didactic materials that integrate with technology, TLNCU expects that at the end of 2024, six trainers will train by SEAMEO STEMED-ED and be able to conduct teacher training for 78 science and math teachers around 13 municipalities. So that, at the end of 2025, they can apply it to the students in their schools.
